en: A black‑and‑white image showing a multi‑arched stone railway viaduct crossing a deep, wooded valley in a rural, hilly landscape. Train tracks run along the top of the viaduct with a signal mast visible near one end. Beyond the bridge are open fields and dense forested hills. The photograph has irregularly cut borders, as if mounted or cropped, consistent with early 20th‑century postcard prints.
